title: It Is Best to Live In Your Muslim Homeland
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Yaa Rabbaana salli `alaa habeebika 'l-Mustafa salaatan da'imatan bi-dawaamik baqiyatan bi-baqaa'ik. Zidhu
yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, ridwaana wa sultaanan fee mithli hadh ash-shahru 'shshareef, shahr Dhul-Qa`dah.
Wa salawaatullah wa 's-salaamuhu `alaa saair 'l-anbiyaa wa 'l-awliyaa wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsanin ila
Yawmu 'd-Deen. Asaluka al-`afuw wa 'l-`afiyati wa 's-sitr fi 'd-dunya wal-akhirah. Yaa Rabbana ighfir
warham wa anta arhamu'r-rahimeen wa akramul-akrameen. Thumma salaamu `alayk yaa Saahib az-Zamaan
wa 's-salaam `ala `ibadillah as-saaliheen wa as-haab an nawba. yaa Awtaad, Ya Aqtaab, Yaa Nujabaa, yaa
Nuqabaa, yaa Budalaa, yaa Akhyaar, yaa Akhtaab, zadakumullah `izzan wa sharafan wa haybatan wa
waqaara! And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits)

As-salaamu `alaykum, our Attenders! How you are reaching today, the end of your work? How is your
business today, going up or coming down? Shari`atullah is never accepting to work with paper currency. If it
circulates among people, never-ending problems and troubles will continue and cannot be stopped. There
will be no solution for your economical crisis until you remove paper money and replace it with gold, silver,
and copper (coins). Then, in forty days everything will come to its real position.
O our Attenders, from common people! That is for you. Yes, I know it is a Sunday and there is no work as it is
a holiday. Therefore you are saying, "What we can say for Shaykh? Today is a holiday and we are not doing
anything; it is an empty day." You know about empty days every week for dunya, but what about for your
future, for your Next Life? These days will come back on the Day of Resurrection, seen by everyone, and
angels will say to them, "You were in dunya, seeing if it was an empty day or a full day, but for what? For
money, for richness? But you were never thinking about your Hereafter and in 24 hours what was your
profit? Daily you thought about it, but you never thought about your last station, where you would be forever!
So what was your profit? You were unhappy if your profits in dunya decreased, and so happy when your
profit increased. But today you are looking at all your days in dunya and you will be ashamed, because you
never thought of a heavenly profit!"
O our Attenders! What is that heedlessness from Mankind today? Why are you taking so much? You are so
happy to reach limits, but you never ask what is your true aim for that day? That is a general view held by all
Mankind, from east to west, thinking and desiring to reach a limit. If it decreases you are unhappy, but you
don't ask, "What is our profit for the Next Life, the Eternal Life?" Is there no scale for you to think on it? This
is a muwaqqat, temporary life, and you will be so sorry if you reach its limit, and no one knows if their life will
finish tomorrow or not. But you are never taking any care for your permanent, Eternal Life! Why are you not
looking, what is that heedlessness? Are you drunk? Some are drunk from alcohol, but others are drunk from
thinking about this limited life's pleasures. Most of them are losing and they never gain.
O our Salafi `ulamas! Where are you (what is your position)? Allah Almighty is giving you `ilm, knowledge
from the Holy Qur'an, so why are you not waking people up? Why are you not calling people to understand
the realities of this life and the coming life? This life is temporary, and that one is permanent. Why are you
not saying this? Make it clear, the ghaya, for what did the Lord of Heavens create Mankind? You must repeat
this over and over again, daily. Fadhakkir! That is a holy command from Allah Almighty:

••••••••• •••••••• ••••• ••••••••• ••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••••
Fadhakkir innamaa anta mudhdhakkir lasta `alayhim bi-musaytir. And so (O Prophet), remind them; your
task is only to remind. You are not one to manage (men's) affairs. (88:21-22)
Where are your broadcasts? I am sorry to say that broadcast centers are only making music and amusement,
making people dance. Why are you not taking this away? Your maqsad, purpose, behind these broadcasts is
to make your dirty egos happy. There is no broadcast calling people to reality here and Hereafter! What is
that? Laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem!
Those are the wrong ways of those who claim, "We are Salafiyoon." Why are they not calling people? Why are
Salafi and Wahhabi people running to western countries? Why are they not making their broadcast to reach
from east to west? Why are they making hijrah, immigration, from Arabia and the Islamic world to western
countries? What is the benefit? Particularly Salafi and Wahhabi people are running there, "We are doing
da`wah, inviting people to Islam." How many people are you bringing to Islam through da`wah? How are
you calling people to Islam? No, you are going to those countries for your nafs, and the Lord of Heavens
knows! You may cheat people, but you cannot cheat your Creator, Allah Almighty!
We are judged by our niyyah, intention. Wahhabis and Salafis living in England, Paris, America, and in
European countries must come back. For workers, there is a second position. But when people ask Wahabis
and Salafis, "Why did you come to live in England?" you answer, "We are people of da`wah." Don't do
da`wah there, you should come back! You are really there to enjoy freedoms, as everything is free there but
not in Islamic countries. We know and all awliyaa know, also! Therefore, they are addressing me to say,
"Leave da`wah there and come to your homelands and make broadcastings every 24 hours to bombard
them." Why? They are not making me speak wrong things here, no. I am in an unknown place on the map,
but they are making me call people from east to west, from north to south, to declare to them reality. There is
no hope for me for dunya; I am not asking for dunya, no, it is finished. Everyone must prepare their coffin as
they will be called on any day, or at any hour, "Finish your days in this temporary life and come to Me now,
and say what you did for Me."
O Wahhabi People! Is it true? Use your mind and listen. You must accept the truth; if not, heavenly cursing
will come on your heads and touch you! What is haraam, prohibited, in Islam is given freedom in western

countries. Then why are you going there? Do you really believe you are able to control your egos? No! Awliya
know what you are doing there, but they are not disclosing it in public. Come to your countries and call
people! Come to real Islam, real humanity, or real obedience for the Lord of Heavens, Who created us! If not,
your names will be written under the list of liars and hypocrites, and heavenly lights are taken away mostly
from those people! If you look at them, you would want to run away. They can't do anything because they are
donkeys for their egos. May Allah forgive us.
O People! Try to understand, as the Seal of Prophets (s) was informed in the Holy Qur'an, fasta`eedhu billah:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
•••••• ••••• ••••••••••••
Faqad jaa ashraatuhaa. But some of its Signs (of the Last Hour) have already come. (Muhammad, 47:18)
(Mawlana sits) O Salafi `ulamas! Do you understand? Allama tu sa'aa, Signs of the Last Day just arrived.
Holy Qur'an said it fifteen centuries ago, so why you are not taking care? Why you are not making clear what
are the Signs of Last Day? Why are you not saying? Leave everything and say to all, "O People! The Last Day,
Yawm ul-Qiyamah is approaching and the Signs are this and this." why not saying? Where are you (what is
your position)? Show me which broadcasting says, "O People! The Signs of Qiyamah began fifteen centuries
ago." What about now, are you waiting to see the big Signs of Qiyamah?
••••• •••••• ••••••• •••••••••
Inna batsha rabbika la-shadeed. Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of your Lord. (85:12)
O People! When the Last Hour comes, it is going to be difficult for people, because inna batsha rabbika lashadeed, Allah Almighty's powerful punishment punch will come on people. Hear this warning and think on
it before that heavenly punch comes on your heads, turning you to burnt bodies and dust! Take care! Those
are Signs of the Day of Resurrection. May Allah forgive us and give us more understanding. Therefore, I am
always attacking Salafi `ulamas about making themselves a distinguished group of learned people. What you
are teaching people?
O Muslims! O Mankind! What are you doing for humanity? Where are those people to whom Allah Almighty
granted wealth, power, and capability? Why they are making these important points to people, to make it

clear that they must not run so hurriedly on their destinations? They must be careful that their destinations
are good; if not they will fall into bad destinations and no one can save themselves.
O People! We are attacking those who make themselves in special stations or who give themselves special
titles, but they are not doing what they claim! They must say to Azhar ash-Shareef `ulamas and to "doctors"
of Shari`ah. How are you doctors? What are the illnesses of people? What is dangerous to them? You are
writing books, but who is going to read books? Sit down and warn people that we entered the Last Days!
O People! Take your care. If a train enters a tunnel, windows are quickly closed so nothing from outside will
come inside the train. You must say at least to people, "Close (any windows to evil) and take care that evil will
not touch you here and Hereafter." That is your most important mission!
May Allah forgive you, and me also. Stand for the honor of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
(33 minutes) May Allah forgive us. Yaa Rabbee, shukr. Shukr yaa Rabb. Forgive us. Shukran lillah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`at Salaat ash-Shukr.)
